# Did an AI assistant just suggest a package that doesn't exist?

> Paste your package.json and this offline check flags any dependency name that looks like a one- or two-letter typo of a famous npm package -- the same shape as a hallucinated name an AI coding assistant invents.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
